body:
I have been using tramadol for over a year now and have only good things to say about it. I have found it best to split doses into half over a 45 minute period as the bioavailability increases over time.
I take a 3 dose of 50mg and repeat.
It's like any other opiate. I have take vicodin, norco, percocet, oxys, and just about any other opiate you can think of. The buzzes are similar in ways such as the craving for cigs and the generic euphoric feelings I have. The major difference is that trammies last for a much longer period. 10 mg norcos last me about 1 1/2 max from onset to end, but tramadol last me a good 6 hrs and that's after years of opiate abuse.
The downside to tramadol is the WD suck more then any other opiate I have abused. But to every action there is an equal and opposite reaction, the better I feel on the drug then the worse I feel without them.
This drug is great as it contains no acetaminophen which in large doses causes insulin absorption to decrease and high blood sugar means no opiate buzz.
